node.acceptance_condition: Returns (a) a 1–2 sentence plain-prose definition of kitsch and (b) 3–5 numbered diagnostic marks, each with one sentence of explanation; total at most 200 words; no citations, no named theorists required, and not drafted as essay paragraphs.
node.expected_contribution: The working definition and diagnostic criteria of kitsch that the final essay will apply to AI art.
node.objective: Produce a compact, plain-language working definition of kitsch for a general educated reader, plus 3–5 diagnostic marks by which a reader can recognize kitsch (such as pre-digested emotion, formulaic cliche, effortless consumption, reassurance rather than challenge), each explained in one sentence, with brief plain-language historical texture about how the term is ordinarily used in criticism.
node.rationale: The essay's thesis applies the concept of kitsch to AI art; without a fixed, reader-friendly yardstick the argument floats. This child supplies the conceptual tool the parent will wield, in the accessible register the genre demands.
